title: Introduce presubmit shared-venv and stable-dep-roller
author: Maya Thompson
description:
Motivation: our Python presubmit lanes are the largest contributor to CI setup time and flakiness. Multiple jobs rebuild isolated virtualenvs and reinstall transitive dependencies that rarely change, which inflates latency and increases rate of spurious failures. This PR introduces two complementary changes: 1) a presubmit shared-venv GitHub Action + runner-side cache to reuse a verified virtualenv across presubmit shards, and 2) a stable-dep-roller tool that deterministically updates dependency pins via a weekly job and opens a roll PR with lockfile and dep-stamp metadata.

What this changes: single continuous description of intent and changes: the shared-venv action creates/validates a repo-scoped virtualenv under runner cache and exports a deterministic VENV_HASH used by downstream jobs; fallback to ephemeral venv is available via action input. The stable-dep-roller inspects pyproject.toml/requirements.in, produces a lockfile, writes a dep-stamp (deps/stamp.txt) that lists top-level pins and a short provenance blob, and opens a draft PR when updates are non-empty. Presubmit pipelines now skip expensive installs if the VENV_HASH matches and requirements haven't changed.

Migration plan and safety: rollout is opt-in per workflow using the new action input preserve_existing: true. We added an allowlist for workflows that must keep isolation (security-heavy jobs). The dep-roller PRs are opened as draft and include CI smoke runs; if a roller PR fails tests it is blocked from auto-merge and alerts the owners. We added a feature flag in .github/ci-config.yml to disable shared-venv globally if we need to revert quickly.

Checklist:
- [x] shared-venv composite action and runner cache glue (small shell entrypoint + python validator)
- [x] dep-roller prototype and lockfile generator (with reproducible hashing)
- [x] updated presubmit workflows opt-in examples under .github/workflows/*
- [x] docs for maintainers (docs/ci/presubmit.md) and roll guidelines
- [x] telemetry hooks (ci-telemetry: presubmit_venv_reused)
- [x] tests: unit tests for dep-roller and integration smoke workflow run in CI

Risks and mitigations: the main risk is a stale shared-venv being used to test incompatible code; mitigated by VENV_HASH invalidation when pyproject/requirements or Python runtime image changes, and by a per-repo TTL for caches. Dep-roller introduces additional PR churn; we limit to weekly and only when pins move.

Related: references ENG-4021 (presubmit perf), ENG-4033 (dep hygiene).

review_comments: Priya Nair: Please add a TTL and explicit invalidation when the Python runtime tag changes — shared caches are brittle across image bumps.
Maya Thompson: Added TTL=7d configuration and invalidation on python_version / runner-image digest change in the action inputs; documented in docs/ci/presubmit.md.
Liam O'Connor: The dep-roller PR body should include the exact pip resolver flags and the lockfile provenance. Also add an option to create a single aggregate PR for multiple repos (future work).
Maya Thompson: Included resolver flags and provenance blob in dep-stamp; aggregate-roll is tracked in ENG-4100 — out of scope for this PR.

Diego Ramirez: CI failed on lint in first run due to shellcheck warnings in entrypoint.sh; prefer POSIX sh and remove set -o pipefail on runners that don't support it. Also request a small e2e smoke with cached vs clean venv.
Maya Thompson: Fixed shell portability issues and added an e2e smoke job that runs presubmit twice to assert cache reuse metrics.
Priya Nair: Approve after the TTL and docs changes. Verified the roller PR created a draft and CI smoke passed on a local dry-run.
merge_outcome: merged on 2026-02-23 via squash and merge; merge commit message: feat(ci): presubmit shared-venv + stable dep-roller (ENG-4021, ENG-4033)
release_notes:
- Introduce a reusable presubmit shared-venv action to reduce Python CI setup time and flakiness.
- Add stable-dep-roller that opens weekly draft PRs with updated lockfiles and a dep-stamp for provenance.
- Opt-in presubmit examples and docs added; rollout is opt-in and guarded by a feature flag.
notes_for_release_manager: This is backward-compatible; default workflows remain unchanged. To enable org-wide toggle see .github/ci-config.yml. Watch dep-roller PRs for the first two weeks to tune frequency and pin acceptance rules.
